summary_rationale: Titan Company Limited retains COMPOUNDER_PASS on a price-blind business-quality basis, supported by 22.1% 10-year median sales growth, zero primary equity dilution (₹89 Cr share capital since FY15), 20.5% ROCE / 37.7% ROE, ₹10,754 Cr cumulative 12-year Free Cash Flow (₹4,713 Cr in FY26; 10-year FY17–FY26 sum ₹10,134 Cr), [ICRA]AAA (Stable) credit standing reaffirmed on November 25, 2026, 35% studded jewellery mix (+32% YoY), 31% CaratLane growth with double-digit buyer additions, 16.2% standalone (16.7% consolidated) FY26 Watches EBIT margins, and a 75% YoY reduction in Emerging Businesses' Q2 FY27 EBIT loss to ₹6 Cr. However, kpi_health remains firmly at PASS_WITH_WATCH with sharper monitorables uncovered in the November 2026 audit: (1) Q2 FY27 normalized PBT grew 17.8% YoY to ₹1,793 Cr once BOTH pre-tax one-offs (₹671 Cr non-cash Damas put-option credit + ₹536 Cr customs-duty inventory windfall) are removed; (2) core Tanishq/Mia/Zoya buyer count was flat YoY amid -29% national gold tonnage while FY27 jewellery EBIT margin is anchored lower at ~11% (11.1% ex-duty in Q2 after 340 bps FY23–FY26 gross margin compression); (3) Gold-on-Loan fell from ₹16,070 Cr to ₹12,278 Cr (Mar–Sep 2026) while financial debt doubled to ₹24,191 Cr, lifting Q2 finance costs +93.5% YoY to ₹536 Cr (ICRA H1 interest cover 6.6x; Q2 ex-duty EBIT/Interest 4.07x; FY26 net TOL/TNW 2.6x; 222 inventory days); and (4) intensified FOCO competition from Kalyan (546 stores, +31.4% Q2 rev) and Indriya (100+ stores in 28 months with 45%–55% old-gold exchange), plus -82% LGD export price deflation and West Asia conflict headwinds at Damas (~122 active GCC doors).
